worldcombat.skill.grasswhistle.summary: Puts a leaf to its lips and blows one straight whistle down the line from itself to the target, piercing the first foe and carrying on into the ones behind: everyone in the sound lane is taken by that single note. It needs a wall-free straight line, though allies' bodies do not block sound; one note either rings true or cracks, and whether it rings is a contest of the user's Special Attack and level against the target's Special Defence and level.
worldcombat.skill.grasswhistle.use.0: Drop a whole line of foes at once through an ally in the way
worldcombat.skill.grasswhistle.use.1: Pin a threat that is backing away from range
worldcombat.skill.grasswhistle.use.2: Line foes up with an ally's positioning and take them together
worldcombat.skill.grasswhistle.descripti: The lane is %1$s long and %2$s half-wide, piercing up to %3$s foes; it needs a straight line not blocked by solid walls, but allies' bodies do not block sound.

The note currently rings with %1$s chance (the user's Special Attack and level against the target's Special Defence and level); if it rings the target sleeps for %2$s, if it cracks the whole lane is just a rasp.
It spreads %1$s sound rings down the lane and travels at %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.grasswhistle.narrow.on: Narrow pipe: lane half-width ×0.7, pierce +2 foes and sleep ×1.1, at the cost of cooldown ×1.15 and a harder line to line foes up on.
worldcombat.skill.grasswhistle.narrow.of: Broad tone: lane half-width ×1.4 and easier to catch a loose cluster, at the cost of pierce −1 foe, sleep ×0.85 and cooldown ×0.9.
worldcombat.skill.grasswhistle.growth.0: From level %1$s the rings are %2$s and it pierces up to %3$s foes.
worldcombat.skill.grasswhistle.growth.1: From level %1$s the rings are %2$s, the sleep %3$s and the lane %4$s long.
worldcombat.skill.grasswhistle.preferenc: On: lane half-width ×0.7, pierce +2 foes and sleep ×1.1, but cooldown ×1.15 and a harder line to line foes up on — for threading a very thin note through a queue. Off (broad tone): half-width ×1.4, easier to sweep a loose cluster, but pierce −1 foe and sleep ×0.85.
Beyond this distance the partner will not blow first but closes in; larger lets it try a note from farther away.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to blow the whistle; when off it only plays where it already reaches.
